articles.title: Coca-Cola hires Rob Gehring from Monster Energy to run its North American operations
articles.summary: Rob Gehring, the head of Monster Energy's Americas business, will leave to run Coca-Cola's North America unit, the companies said Friday. The move comes as Coke tries to maintain growth while U.S. Coke shares have climbed more than 25% this year, while Monster's stock has risen more than 12%.

articles.title: Surging Treasury yields pose a brand new problem for Kevin Warsh and the Fed
articles.summary: Treasury yields continued their upward march Thursday as investors sought to price in a variety of factors: inflation still hovering well above the Fed's 2% goal, another bump up in energy prices and the impact of a global hyperscaler financial arms race and accompanying debt issuance. "The bias has to be towards restoring price stability, and they should take what's going on seriously." Markets expect the central bank will indeed take a firmer hand on inflation.
